title: ️ Strange Art, Real People
content:
:emoji: If H.R. Giger Made HyperCard Stacks... Welcome to the dark, drippy dream world of the "vestigial sexual needs and kinks of the various biomechanical components of a self-aware post-human spaceship". It's like someone gave an '80s goth kid a Mac and told them to channel their nightmares into something... clickable. This is so Not Safe For Work, so proceed with caution!

:emoji:️ "This Post Sucks" And That's Totally The Point! No, really. Literally even! This post is a lovingly curated collection of things that suck, blow, inhale, exhale, and otherwise interact with air in compelling ways. From vacuums to bellows to reverse-engineered fans, this thread is equal parts satisfying and delightfully niche.
author: Brandon Blatcher
